exercises.answer: A good score is a useful credential, yet the real reward may be the power to read any text with ease, the fruit of honest endeavour; we may not let one hard question intrude on the whole test, for the next may be easy.
exercises.note: the power to read any text with ease 中,不定式修饰 power。

lessonGrammar.name: 时间状语短语
lessonGrammar.note: During the review season 是介词短语作时间状语。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: During the review season, our class may meet in the big auditorium, and each person may share one useful trick.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 在复习季期间,我们班可能在大礼堂聚会,每个人都可以分享一个有用的窍门。

lessonGrammar.name: more than 结构
lessonGrammar.note: more than a test 表示「不只是测试」。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: A fill-in test may be more than a test of vocabulary, for a correct option may depend on the grammar of a sentence and the logic of the passage.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 完形填空可能不只是词汇测试,因为正确的选项可能取决于句子的语法和文章的逻辑。

lessonGrammar.name: for 表示原因
lessonGrammar.note: for 补充说明完形为何不只是词汇测试。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: A fill-in test may be more than a test of vocabulary, for a correct option may depend on the grammar of a sentence and the logic of the passage.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 完形填空可能不只是词汇测试,因为正确的选项可能取决于句子的语法和文章的逻辑。

lessonGrammar.name: 完形技巧
lessonGrammar.note: 完形填空的正确答案常由语法搭配与篇章逻辑共同决定,是本单元复习技巧的核心。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: A fill-in test may be more than a test of vocabulary, for a correct option may depend on the grammar of a sentence and the logic of the passage.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 完形填空可能不只是词汇测试,因为正确的选项可能取决于句子的语法和文章的逻辑。

lessonGrammar.name: treat A as B
lessonGrammar.note: treat A as B 表示「把 A 当作 B」。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: We may treat every fill-in as a puzzle, and a sly option may look perfect at first sight, yet a small sign in the text may give it away.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 我们可以把每道完形当作谜题,而狡猾的选项乍看之下可能完美无缺,但文本中的一个小迹象就会暴露它。
